Timing: the rise came about a year before the November 2016 IMF programme. IPN says the IMF would negotiate if tariffs were adjusted, and later lists cost-recovery tariffs as an upfront condition, but no IMF money was in force. Harm is the rise itself and a protest of dozens, and compensation was planned. The 30% and 0.42 lei figures were only on one IPN page, with the year inferred.

Link: IMF Press Release 16/355 only credits 'the adoption of the civil service pension reform' and urges 'timely implementation'. No source calls it a condition. Harm: later retirement and higher contributions for civil servants are a workplace pay dispute.

Link: the IMF Board welcomed the 9 November rise on 21 December. The staff report (Country Report 19/15) does not label it a prior action or benchmark, and records a commitment to cost recovery 'going forward'. Press reports on the rise do not mention the IMF. Harm: price rise and a march; no arrests or injuries reported.

Harm: the president postponed the rise before bills came due, said 75% of households would keep their subsidy, and the IMF says the rises were partly reversed. No source shows households paying more. The rally reflects feared harm. Inflation of 77% had other causes.

Link: Bretton Woods Project itself says the IMF was careful not to condition the 2019 loan on social spending cuts; no document names the dismissals. Harm: dismissals alone are a workplace dispute, the 3,680 figure comes from one advocacy group's analysis, and no source ties deaths to them. ecuador-october-2019 and ecuador-2025-public-dismissals already cover this programme's measures.

Harm: three electricity rises of 5% and a VAT rise, with only one resident's remark that medicines had risen for three years; business warnings of job losses are feared harm. The link is real but disputed: the Daily Star calls subsidy cuts a programme stipulation, the Prime Minister said almost no conditions, and The Business Standard says the policy dates to a 2012 pledge. The large diesel and gas rises came before the loan. Could return if a measure of household loss is found.
